Function.Name: read_text_file
Function.Description: Read the content of one or more text files. Pass filePaths (an array) to read all files you need in a single call - strongly preferred over multiple single-file calls.

filePath.description: The path to a single file to read (or use filePaths)

filePaths.description: Paths of multiple files to read in one call

Function.Name: write_text_file
Function.Description: Write content to a text file

filePath.description: The path to the file to write

content.description: The content to write to the file

Function.Name: scan_folder
Function.Description: List the contents of a single folder as a compact ASCII listing: directories first (ending with '/'), then files with byte sizes. Use this to expand a subfolder mentioned in a truncated scan_folder_tree result.

folderPath.description: The path to the folder to scan

filePath.description: The path to the file to delete

Function.Name: delete_folder
Function.Description: Delete a folder and its contents

folderPath.description: The path to the folder to delete
The path to the folder to create

Function.Name: scan_folder_tree
Function.Description: Scan a folder and return a compact indented text tree of files and folders (directories end with '/'). Output is capped at 400 entries; if truncated, call scan_folder on a subfolder to expand it.

folderPath.description: The path to the folder to scan

mode.description: Scanning mode: Flat (single level), BreadthFirst (level by level), DepthFirst (branch by branch)

maxDepth.description: Maximum depth to scan (0 = root only, 1 = root + immediate children, etc.)

filePatterns.description: Array of file patterns to include (e.g., ["*.txt", "*.json"])

excludePatterns.description: Array of directory patterns to exclude (e.g., ["node_modules", ".git"])
